pattern: Labelled group of labelled text inputs (segmented date field). No APG pattern exists for segmented date fields; native text inputs are used for maximum assistive technology compatibility.

aria.value: Localized segment name (Year, Month, Day, Hour, Minute, AM/PM)
description, timezone/DST hint, and error ids as applicable
true while an error message is shown

keyboard.action: Increment/decrement with wrap (year clamps); toggles AM/PM.
Move to previous/next segment (mirrored in RTL).
Pad the current value and advance.
Move between segments and out of the group.

focus: Each segment is a tab stop; focusing selects its content. Focused segment is highlighted with selected colors and a focus outline.
notes: Error messages identify the problem and, for DST cases, the timezone.
Adjustments caused by daylight-saving rules are disclosed in the hint rather than applied silently (SPEC section 8.5).
knownCaveats: Each segment is a separate tab stop; some users may prefer a single field. Manual screen-reader and user testing is pending.
